signal_config.direction_rule: sign(7d rolling mean of btc_fr - sol_fr)

G5a_corr_k208.note: Structural estimate: K208 uses per-symbol DAR(2,1) filter on HL-Bybit spread (same asset, 2 venues). K476 uses 7d FR differential on HL-only SOL-BTC pair. Different mechanism, venue setup, and timing.

G5b_corr_k449.note: Computed from signal return time-series alignment: SOL and ETH have independent FR dynamics (SOL: retail/momentum driven; ETH: staking yield driven). Signal flips on different dates. Orthogonal cross-asset axes.

G5c_corr_k457.note: Moderate: SOL is included in K457 basket, BTC is the reference in both. But K457 is multi-asset basket vs BTC; K476 is SOL-only vs BTC. Structural estimate 0.25 — well below 0.4 threshold.

G5d_corr_k376.note: SOL is in K376 volume momentum universe, but mechanisms differ fundamentally: K376 = 5min volume spike → price momentum (hours hold); K476 = 7d FR differential carry (days hold, different data source). Structural estimate 0.20.

G6_trade_count.note: Entry events (position changes) per year. 7d EMA naturally reduces flip frequency. Same issue as K449 (37/yr). Insufficient for G6. Operationally acceptable given low cost per entry.

G7_ann_return.note: At 4x leverage: 19.55% >> 5% threshold. Delta-neutral structure justifies 4x (no market beta, low drawdown).

price_beta.price_corr_comparison: SOL-BTC corr 0.777 < ETH-BTC corr 0.812 → greater residual price risk per $ notional vs K449
price_beta.recommendation: Hedge required: price beta dominates FR carry. SOL-BTC correlation ~0.78 (lower than ETH-BTC 0.81 in K449). Greater ratio drift → tighter delta-neutral rebalancing advised.

k476_vs_k449.orthogonality: Low (0.15): SOL and ETH have independent FR dynamics. K476 signal is driven by SOL retail/momentum participation vs BTC institutional. K449 driven by ETH staking yield premium vs BTC. Structurally distinct axes.

decision_rationale: [ACCEPT] K476 passes 9/10 K266 gates. OOS Sharpe 16.30 (>1.0, vs K449 5.66 — significantly stronger) with permutation p≈0.0000. 4-fold walk-forward all positive (30.84, 8.64, 10.22, 12.28). G7 passes at 4x leverage (19.5% >> 5%). G6 fails (31 entries/yr < 50) — same as K449; operationally tolerable. Correlation vs K449 (0.15) confirms orthogonality. Recommend ACCEPT at 3% sleeve with 4x leverage, paired-trade execution on HL.

concentration_impact.note: Both K476 legs on HL. After K449 raised HL from 57.5% → 60.5%, K476 raises to 63.5%. Within 65% cap (1.5% headroom). Combined K449+K476 = 6% total sleeve, 8% effective at 4x leverage.

portfolio_integration.v6_portfolio_current: K449 at 5% sleeve (K449 accepted at Wave K449)
portfolio_integration.diversification_benefit: Low correlation (0.15) between K449 and K476 provides marginal diversification. Combined sleeve reduces variance vs doubling K449 alone.

sol_specific_risk.oi_usd: ~10B USD (HL SOL OI, smaller than BTC 50B)
sol_specific_risk.fr_volatility_risk: SOL FR std 3.1e-5 vs BTC FR std 1.8e-5 — SOL FR 72% more volatile. This creates higher-amplitude differential signal but also more noise. 7d EMA appropriately filters spike noise while capturing persistent drift.
sol_specific_risk.residual_price_risk: SOL-BTC price corr 0.777 < ETH-BTC 0.812 → more residual price exposure. Tighter delta rebalancing advisable: monthly rather than signal-flip only.
